description.value: Days Inn by Wyndham Surrey is a 2-star budget hotel sitting on King George Boulevard, a major north-south arterial through Metro Vancouver's southern suburbs. It is part of the Wyndham franchise network and caters to road-side travellers passing through the Surrey–Delta corridor. Touring cyclists coming off the Trans Canada Trail or heading toward the ferry terminals at Tsawwassen may find it a practical overnight base in an otherwise urban stretch.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is almost entirely generic Wyndham Hotels corporate navigation and booking-interface boilerplate; it yields no property-specific amenity details for the Days Inn Surrey location. OSM tags supply the core identifiers (address, phone, brand, star rating) and two amenity tags (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no), but per the rules these cannot be treated as authoritative without website confirmation. All cyclist-specific amenity fields therefore remain null. The hotel is confirmed as a real, open, 2-star Days Inn franchise on King George Boulevard in Surrey.
concerns: Website content captured is almost entirely generic Wyndham corporate navigation boilerplate with no property-specific amenity or contact information for the Days Inn Surrey location; some subpages belong to other Wyndham brands (WaterWalk, Hawthorn Extended Stay), suggesting the crawl pulled in brand-level rather than property-level pages. Phone and address could not be cross-checked against the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible 2-star hotel at a confirmed address in Surrey, BC. Suitable overnight stop for touring cyclists transiting the Metro Vancouver southern suburbs.

wow_evidence: part of the Wyndham franchise network
